blocks.text: A new rooftop destination, Onyx Skylounge, has opened above Amber Hotel in Fuente Osmeña, giving Cebu City’s dining scene a fresh vantage point. Onyx Skylounge sits several floors above the traffic circle that has anchored the city for generations, where guests can now watch the afternoon haze soften into evening light over plates of Filipino comfort food and a cold drink in hand. A new view above Fuente Osmeña Fuente Osmeña has always been a meeting point for Cebuanos—a rotunda ringed by hotels, offices, and the steady hum of jeepneys circling below.
